text:
Platinum Price in 1998
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1998, the LBMA platinum price fell 6.8% between 1998-01-30 ($387) and 1998-12-30 ($360). The highest sampled price was $407 in March and the lowest was $334 in October. The mean of these observations was $369. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
